chosen.title: The 127x Liquidity Choke Point
chosen.idea: A stark, high-contrast structural layout anchored by a massive monospace hero metric: '127x'. Beneath the stat, an architectural scale diagram renders a precision cross-section: an immense top-heavy reservoir block labeled 'Blend Lending ($157.16M)' resting entirely on a micro-aperture labeled 'Soroswap AMM ($1.24M)'. Fine hairline callouts trace the mechanical reality: liquidating collateral in a unified pool forces total protocol volume through a secondary market capable of absorbing less than 1% of debt before extreme slippage triggers cascading deficits.
chosen.why: This is the strongest concept because it directly honors the prompt angle: strictly emphasizing the mathematical liquidity mismatch (127:1) rather than assuming active insolvencies. Using the hero_stat layout breaks away from the recently overused comparison and sequence layouts, delivering an immediate, arresting punch that quantifies systemic exposure at a single glance.

all.title: The Socialization Axiom
all.idea: An austere, editorial typographic layout presenting a single uncompromising structural thesis: 'When secondary liquidity cannot clear a cascade, pooled architecture makes every depositor absorb the deficit.' The typography is set in oversized, surgical Swiss grotesque, enclosed in a tight architectural bounding box with precision coordinate markers. The bottom edge displays fine monospace metadata tracking the raw ledger snapshot: 'BLEND TVL: $157,161,882 // SOROSWAP TVL: $1,238,140 // LEDGER LOAD: 0.08'.
all.why: It elevates the brand above standard crypto noise with authoritative editorial design, focusing purely on the systemic mechanism of pooled risk without leaning on repetitive visual diagrams.

all.title: Shared Basin vs. Watertight Bulkheads
all.idea: A dual-register technical blueprint comparing hydraulic failure modes. The upper panel ('Pooled Lending') depicts a single shared basin where a deep fluid volume of $157.16M breaches a single thin outflow point of $1.24M, causing backpressure that contaminates all connected chambers simultaneously. The lower panel ('Isolated Credit Architecture') depicts the exact same volume segmented into discrete structural bulkheads: a failure at one outflow point remains entirely sealed inside its individual vertical cell, leaving adjacent collateral pools completely uncompromised.
all.why: It physically demonstrates why compartmentalization prevents ecosystem-wide spillover, clearly illustrating risk relief while strictly treating the issue as a spatial structural problem rather than an active balance sheet crisis.
